record.question: What is the purpose of 'echo time (TE)' in MRI?
options: To measure the time between the radiofrequency pulse and the signal received
To adjust the magnetic field strength
record.explanation: Answer A: To measure the time between the radiofrequency pulse and the signal received. TE is the interval from the RF excitation to measurement/formation of the echo signal. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mri; https://cs.acr.org/-/media/ACR/Files/Radiology-Safety/MR-Safety/Manual-on-MR-Safety.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
